name: Homer City Energy Campus — photographic art direction
status: Experiment. Drives generated imagery on the Figma page 'Desktop Experiment' (file 8RV4XecnHv5rFzjQVnSuNV). Generated images are stand-ins until the client photo library (CLAUDE.md §10 #4) is available.
intent: A real place being built in real country. Big, calm, wide frames that show the scale of the campus inside the rolling farmland and forest of Indiana County, Pennsylvania. Documentary, never staged. Quiet, warm-faded colour that sits comfortably next to a near-white, near-black, Geist-set interface.

rules.scale: Prefer large-scale shots: high drone aerials, oblique aerials, satellite-style top-downs and wide ground-level landscapes. Close-ups only for objects and materials (steel, conduit, turbine parts), never for people.
rules.people: No faces. People appear only as small figures in wide or aerial frames, or from behind. No portraits, no group photos posed for camera, no identifiable individuals.
rules.sky: Clear. Cloudless or near-cloudless pale-to-deep blue, or a clean low-sun haze at the horizon. No overcast, no storm cover, no dramatic cumulus.
rules.season: Late summer through autumn by default: deep green woodland, rust, amber and gold tree lines, harvested patchwork fields. Light frost or snow is allowed only for timeline/history frames.
rules.text_and_marks: No text, signage, logos, brand marks, licence plates or watermarks anywhere in frame. Equipment is unbranded.
rules.realism: Photographs must look taken, not generated. Include real-site imperfections: uneven crowd density and stragglers, people facing different ways, tyre marks and dust on fresh asphalt, puddle stains, patched gravel, stray cones and barrels, mismatched pickup trucks, mud on equipment, slightly crooked delineator posts, utility poles and overhead lines, dumpsters and portable toilets at the edges, mild drone lens softness toward the corners, slight sensor noise. No perfect symmetry, no evenly spaced people, no showroom-clean equipment.
rules.honesty: The campus is under construction. Frames of finished buildings are renderings by definition — keep them in a clean architectural-render style so they never pass as a photograph of something that exists. Do not depict cooling towers, coal stockpiles or smoke plumes as part of the new campus.

grade.blacks: Lifted — deepest shadows sit around #1E2326, never pure black.
grade.highlights: Warm, soft roll-off; no clipped whites.
grade.saturation: Reduced ~20–30%. Hi-vis orange and crane yellow stay legible but never neon.
grade.texture: Very fine film grain; gentle atmospheric haze toward the horizon.

light.default: Clear daylight, sun mid-to-low (roughly 9–11am or 3–5pm), long soft shadows across graded ground.
light.hero: Late afternoon, low warm sun raking across the site, clear sky with a soft haze band at the horizon.

camera.aerial_high: Drone at 120–400 m, 20–45° down-angle, 24–35 mm equivalent; horizon in the top fifth or out of frame.
camera.aerial_top_down: 90° nadir, satellite-like; land-use pattern reads as texture (forest, field strips, roads, pads).
camera.aerial_oblique: Drone at 60–150 m, 15–30° down-angle; the structure in context of the hills behind it.
camera.ground_wide: Eye level or low angle, 24 mm; structure dominant, people tiny or absent.
camera.detail: Material close-up, shallow depth of field, soft round bokeh; objects only.
camera.render: Clean architectural/product render: matte grey and graphite materials, soft shadow, flat plain background, no photographic noise.

place: Rolling wooded ridges of western Pennsylvania receding to a long horizon
Contour-strip and patchwork farm fields in greens, browns and harvested gold
Two Lick Creek–style wooded stream valleys between ridges
A small brick main-street town with flat roofs, a rail line and a pale water tower
site_now: Grey rock and gravel graded pads, haul roads with tyre tracks
Tall yellow lattice crawler cranes and tower cranes
New grey and white steel frames for turbine halls going vertical
Electrical conduit duct banks — grey PVC runs in white spacers
The existing switchyard: steel lattice and transformers
Beige modular site offices, rows of pickup trucks, a rail spur
The dark boiler structures and pale blue silos of the former generating station, at the edge of frame
site_future_render: Seven gas turbine units in a regular grid on a light-grey concrete pad
Each unit: a rectangular turbine hall, a heat recovery steam generator, one slender white exhaust stack, a dark bank of air-cooled condenser fans
Wide context: campus pads, substation and solar fields set into forest and contour-farmed hills
people: Large gatherings of tradespeople in orange and lime hi-vis and white/yellow/blue hard hats, seen from high above
Ironworkers on steel or in a boom lift, small in frame or from behind

negative: faces, close-up people, portraits, posed group photo, readable text, signage, logos, brand names, licence plates, watermark, overcast sky, storm clouds, dramatic cumulus, cooling-tower steam plumes, smoke, coal piles, desert, sand dunes, palm trees, neon saturation, HDR, fisheye distortion
prompt_template: {shot}. {subject}. Location: Indiana County, western Pennsylvania — rolling wooded ridges and patchwork farmland. Light: {light}. Sky: completely clear, no clouds. Grade: faded cinematic film — lifted blacks, warm soft highlights, slightly teal-tinted shadows, saturation reduced, fine grain, gentle horizon haze. No faces; any people are small figures seen from far above or behind. No text, signage or logos. Documentary realism.
